_comment: === Purchase Order import from OfficeNo1 (SelectLine) 4D database ===
_comment2: Mirrors the officeno1_sales_orders instance: only purchase orders that are NOT fully delivered are imported (allesgeliefert flag), line items come from BESTELLUNGpos
_comment3: Sales orders park the already delivered qty in custom_custom_text_1 / MENGEGELIEFERT; for purchase orders the delivered qty per line is mapped onto the item's received_qty (MengeGeliefert), so per_received is calculated by ERPNext from real numbers
_comment4: IMPORTANT: sl_column, primary_key, order_by, timestamp_column_name and the {PLACEHOLDER} of the child query must be UPPERCASE because the 4D driver returns uppercase dict keys
query_filter: t.[allesgeliefert] IS NULL OR t.[allesgeliefert] = false

fields._comment: --- Keep the ERPNext naming series of the existing (manually created) purchase orders ---

--- Currency is fixed to USD, it is NOT taken from 4D BESTELLUNG.Waehrung any more (PIT-TASK-2027-000365 ADJUSTMENT 3): the customer books the purchases of these suppliers in USD (his own USD purchase orders LNG-BE-2026-0007 .. 0041/0043), and 4D carries 'EUR' for all open orders, which would contradict the USD buying price list. ---
--- Buying price list of the mirrored orders: Standard-Kauf-USD, independent of the 4D currency (PIT-TASK-2027-000365 ADJUSTMENT 3, before: value_map on WAEHRUNG with 'Standard-Kauf' as default) ---

--- USD -> EUR rate fixed (4D UMRECHFRW is 1.0 for the EUR orders and would make the USD order un-convertible). 0.86207 is the rate the customer uses in his own USD purchase orders (LNG-BE-2026-0007 .. 0041; outlier 0.8785 dated 2026-07-02). ERPNext has no Currency Exchange record on this site. ---
--- Source order number (OfficeNo1 BestellNr) for traceability, like the manual POs ---

--- Order lines from BESTELLUNGpos (condition is matched against the parent row). rate/price_list_rate carry the source order price (BESTELLUNGpos.Preis_EK); lines where the source has no price are filled from the USD buying price list by the server script 'fill purchase order prices from usd price list'. ---

table_fields._comment: --- Already delivered qty per line (MengeGeliefert) -> ERPNext received qty / per_received ---
